title: Cultural Safety in Community Responses
description: This module supports community members, volunteers, and local leaders to respond to DFV in culturally safe, respectful, and community-led ways. It focuses on understanding cultural contexts, avoiding assumptions, and building trust with diverse communities.
outcomes: Understand the importance of cultural safety in DFV responses
Recognise how cultural context shapes experiences of DFV and help-seeking
Engage respectfully and safely with diverse communities
